title: Sourcewise universality of the constant finite perfect transition
statement:
theorem finitePerfectAdicEtaleConstant_universal (Y : Scheme.{t})
    {A : Type t} [CommRing A] {d : AdicCoefficientDatum A}
    (T : FinitePerfectAdicAlgebraTower d) (n : ℕ) (U : Y.Etale) :
    Nonempty (StructuredArrow.IsUniversal (StructuredArrow.mk
      (etaleIsomorphismNormalizationArrow Y
        (RingHom.ulift (Ideal.Quotient.factorPowSucc d.ideal (n + 1)))
        (finitePerfectAdicEtaleConstantTransition Y T n) U)))

proof.text: Apply the lifted algebraic universality theorem to the transition and transport its universal constant arrow to every etale source using the canonical coefficient mate.

proof_origin.note: The proof is reduced to the strict algebraic transition universality and generic etale source transport statements.
